public.en: A traditional definition of corruption is the abuse of public office for personal gain.
public.zh: 对腐败的一个传统定义是：滥用公权力以谋取私利。

public.en: The then Justice Secretary was furious. And so were many members of the public.
public.zh: 当时的司法大臣勃然大怒，许多公众成员也同样如此。

public.en: It doesn’t necessarily need to involve a government official or someone in public office.
public.zh: 它不一定非要涉及政府官员或公职人员。

public.en: I have been public speaking in Japanese since the first year I started studying.
public.zh: 从我开始学习的第一年起，我就一直在用日语进行公众演讲。

public.en: The streets were redesigned, public parks were built, and electricity and street cars appeared.
public.zh: 街道被重新规划，公共公园建成，电力和有轨电车也出现了。

purpose.en: But by this period, in many workhouses, it served no productive purpose at all.
purpose.zh: 但在这一时期，在许多济贫院里，它根本没有任何生产用途。

purpose.en: Something which is pointless, has no purpose or meaning and is a waste of time.
purpose.zh: pointless(毫无意义)指的是没有目的、没有意义、纯属浪费时间的事情。

purpose.en: Dedicated can describe something that is designed and used for one particular purpose.
purpose.zh: “专门的”（dedicated）可以描述为某种特定目的设计和使用的东西。

purpose.en: Do English tests improve education? English tests definitely have an important purpose.
purpose.zh: 英语考试能改善教育吗？英语考试绝对有其重要的目的。

purpose.en: That’s the purpose of learning English. It’s not to take an IELTS exam.
purpose.zh: 那才是学习英语的目的。而不是去参加雅思考试。

puzzle.en: None of the original wood remained. And this created a puzzle or a paradox.
puzzle.zh: 原来的木头一点也没有剩下。这就产生了一个谜题或悖论。

puzzle.en: That's the bit of the puzzle that we need to think about going forward.
puzzle.zh: 这是我们未来需要思考的关键一环。

puzzle.en: The phrase a piece of the puzzle means a part of the solution to a problem.
puzzle.zh: 短语 a piece of the puzzle 的意思是解决问题的一环。

puzzle.en: But Hannibal didn’t. Not yet. And this decision, perhaps more than any other, has puzzled historians for centuries.
puzzle.zh: 但Hannibal没有。至少当时没有。这个决定，也许比其他任何决定都更让历史学家们困惑了几个世纪。

puzzle.en: But it must have felt like magic, like you had just figured out the secret to one of the world's greatest puzzles.
puzzle.zh: 但那一定感觉像魔法一样，就像你刚刚解开了世界最大谜团之一的秘密。

publish.en: Another study published a few years earlier by Norris and Ortega found similar things.
publish.zh: 诺里斯（Norris）和奥尔特加（Ortega）几年后发表的另一项研究也发现了类似的结果。

publish.en: All he wanted was for his views to be published in a major newspaper.
publish.zh: 他想要的只是把自己的观点发表在一家大报上。

publish.en: He published an article titled, “The Underground Website Where You Can Buy Any Drug Imaginable”.
publish.zh: 他发表了一篇题为《在这个地下网站，你可以买到任何能想象到的毒品》的文章。

publish.en: Sherlock Holmes’s original stories were published weekly or monthly, I think, in newspapers and magazines.
publish.zh: 我想Sherlock Holmes最初的故事就是每周或每月在报纸和杂志上发表的。

publish.en: You can publish books online, onto Kindle for example, without needing a publisher.
publish.zh: 你可以在网上出版书籍，比如发布到 Kindle 上，而不需要出版商。

pulse.en: Products which already contain protein, like yoghurt, are re-packaged as 'high-protein', while other items have extra protein added, often in the form of beans and pulses.
pulse.zh: 那些本来就含有蛋白质的产品（比如酸奶）被重新包装成“高蛋白”产品，而其他商品则添加了额外的蛋白质，通常是以豆类植物的形式。

pulse.en: Here's Ruth Alexander, presenter of BBC World Service programme The Food Chain: Cast your eye over most aisles in the supermarkets now and you'll see high protein products in abundance: pasta made with lentils and chickpeas rather than wheat flour, bread fortified with beans and pulses.
pulse.zh: 这位是来自BBC世界频道节目The Food Chain的主持人Ruth Alexander：现在随便扫一眼超市里的绝大多数货架，你就会发现大量的高蛋白产品：用扁豆和鹰嘴豆而不是小麦粉制作的意大利面，添加了豆类植物的面包。

pursuit.en: But the pursuit of perfect skin can make life difficult for people who struggle with skin conditions.
pursuit.zh: 但是，对完美皮肤的追求让那些与皮肤问题作斗争的人生活变得艰难。

pursuit.en: While there’s no historical proof that Alexander attempted such a dive, the story has persisted, blending myth and ambition in the pursuit of the deep.
pursuit.zh: 虽然没有历史证据表明亚历山大曾尝试过这样的潜水，但这个故事一直流传下来，在追求深海的过程中将神话与雄心融合在了一起。

pursuit.en: Wyatt Earp, with a small group of men that included Doc Holliday, Warren Earp, and several others, rode out in pursuit of the men they held responsible.
pursuit.zh: Wyatt Earp 带着一小队人马，包括 Doc Holliday、Warren Earp 以及其他几人，骑马出发追杀他们认定的凶手。

punish.en: Should someone be punished for building the tool, or only for how others use it?
punish.zh: 一个人应该因为制造了某种工具而受到惩罚，还是应该只因他人如何使用它而受罚？

punish.en: You wouldn't chastise – criticise or punish - someone for being colour-blind, so why criticise someone's taste?
punish.zh: 你不会因为一个人色盲就去指责(chastise)——也就是批评或惩罚他，那为什么要批评别人的口味呢？

punish.en: If they broke the rules or annoyed the guards, they were punished.
punish.zh: 如果谁违反规定或惹恼了狱警，就会受到惩罚。

punish.en: There also needs to be accountability. There must be strong institutions capable of investigating and punishing corruption.
punish.zh: 同样需要的是问责制。必须有能够调查和惩罚腐败的强力体制。

punish.en: People are much more likely to abuse their power if they know they will not be punished for it, right?
punish.zh: 如果人们知道自己不会因此受到惩罚，他们就更有可能滥用权力，对吧？

pump.en: The treadmill had originally been used to pump water or grind grain.
pump.zh: 跑步机最初是用来抽水或磨谷物的。

pump.en: They pumped lots of money into the financial system, and kept interest rates extremely low, for a very long time.
pump.zh: 他们向金融系统注入了大量资金，并将利率保持在极低水平，而且持续了很长时间。

pump.en: One of the hottest places on Earth, Yuma has been experiencing its worst drought in 500 years, forcing farmers to pump water from rivers to grow their date palm trees.
pump.zh: 尤马是地球上最炎热的地方之一，正经历着500年来最严重的干旱，迫使农民从河流中抽水来种植枣椰树。

pump.en: This would be put on the diver’s head, and there must have been some way of getting the exhaled air out of the bell and pumping fresh air into it, but as the writer was sworn to secrecy, we don’t know exactly how this was achieved.
pump.zh: 这会被放在潜水员的头上，一定有某种方法把呼出的气体排出钟外，并将新鲜空气泵入其中，但由于作者发誓保密，我们不知道这是具体如何实现的。

pure.en: And what followed was not due legal process, it was revenge, pure and simple.
pure.zh: 接下来发生的事，不是什么正当的法律程序，而是彻头彻尾的复仇。

pure.en: And that, she argued, was in some ways more frightening than the idea of pure evil.
pure.zh: 而她认为，这在某些方面，比纯粹的邪恶更令人不寒而栗。

pure.en: The thing is, there really isn't a pure, original version.
pure.zh: 问题是，根本没有一个纯粹的、最初的版本。

pure.en: They perfected distillation, which is a technique that allowed for the extraction of pure, concentrated scents, and is still a method used in modern perfume-making.
pure.zh: 他们完善了蒸馏技术，这是一种能够提取纯净、浓缩香味的技术，至今仍是现代香水制造中使用的方法。

pure.en: When he was a teenager, he received a book that changed his life, “A Synopsis of Elementary Results in Pure and Applied Mathematics” by George Carr.
pure.zh: 在他十几岁时，他得到了一本改变他一生的书——乔治·卡尔（George Carr）的《纯粹与应用数学基本结果概要》。

pudding.en: Black pudding is a traditional spiced blood sausage and part of a traditional breakfast.
pudding.zh: 黑布丁（Black pudding）是一种传统的调味血肠，也是传统早餐的一部分。

pudding.en: A well-made sticky toffee pudding is perhaps the best dessert in the world, in my opinion.
pudding.zh: 在我看来，制作精良的太妃糖布丁（sticky toffee pudding）也许是世界上最好的甜点。

pudding.en: Suet pudding might appear once or twice a week.
pudding.zh: 羊脂布丁可能会一周出现一两次。

punishment.en: And as the days went on, the punishments became more creative…and cruel.
punishment.zh: 随着时间推移，惩罚手段变得越来越“有创意”……也越来越残忍。

punishment.en: They did this by using severe punishments and restricting political freedoms.
punishment.zh: 他们通过严厉惩罚和限制政治自由来达到这一目的。

punishment.en: There needs to be meaningful penalties and punishments for corruption.
punishment.zh: 必须对腐败实行有意义的处罚和惩罚措施。

punishment.en: The guards singled them out for extra punishment, like longer periods in solitary confinement or forcing them to do degrading tasks.
punishment.zh: 狱警对这些人格外惩罚，比如延长单独禁闭的时间，或逼他们做有辱人格的事情。

punishment.en: I think harsher punishments and increasing the chances of someone being caught by having stronger institutions can make corruption less profitable and less common.
punishment.zh: 我认为，通过拥有更强大的体制来加大惩罚力度并提高被抓的概率，可以使腐败变得不那么有利可图，也更加少见。

punch.en: The plot, what actually happens in a Punch and Judy show, is famously violent.
punch.zh: 剧情——也就是 Punch and Judy 演出中实际发生的事情——以暴力闻名。

punch.en: In its heyday, there were an estimated 400 Punch men, or professors, in Britain.
punch.zh: 在其鼎盛时期，英国估计有 400 名 Punch 艺人或“教授”。

puppet.en: A glove puppet, on the other hand, sits directly on the performer's hand.
puppet.zh: 相比之下，手套木偶（glove puppet）直接套在表演者的手上。

puppet.en: The original Mr Punch, Pulcinella, was a marionette: a puppet on strings, operated from above.
puppet.zh: 最初的 Mr Punch，即 Pulcinella，是一个提线木偶（marionette）：一种用绳子从上方操纵的木偶。

puppet.en: He was executed in March of 1314, and less than a year later, both the French king and his puppet pope, Clement V, were also dead.
puppet.zh: 他在1314年3月被处决，不到一年后，法国国王和他的傀儡教皇克莱门特五世也双双身亡。

publication.en: The first two results I got were both from left-leaning publications: Jacobin and The Guardian.
publication.zh: 我得到的头两个结果都来自倾向左翼的刊物：《雅各宾》（Jacobin）和《卫报》（The Guardian）。

publication.en: Satirical publications were more than happy to poke fun at the church.
publication.zh: 讽刺刊物非常乐意拿教会开玩笑。

publication.en: But there is something else worth understanding about what happened to Vance in the years that followed its publication.
publication.zh: 但关于 Vance 在书出版后几年的遭遇，还有另一件事情值得了解。

publication.en: Under the pen name Ralph Robinson, he wrote articles about farming methods for a publication called the Annals of Agriculture.
publication.zh: 他以笔名 Ralph Robinson 在一份名为《农业年鉴》的刊物上撰写关于耕作方法的文章。

publication.en: The second big change was a magazine. In July 1841, two journalists in London started a new weekly satirical publication.
publication.zh: 第二个巨大的改变是一本杂志。1841 年 7 月，伦敦的两位记者创办了一份新的每周讽刺刊物。

purify.en: In 1709, a man named Abraham Darby worked out how to make iron using coke, a purified, high-carbon form of coal.
purify.zh: 1709 年，一个叫亚伯拉罕·达比的人研究出如何使用焦炭（一种经过提纯的高碳形式的煤）来炼铁。

pursue.en: A stable government can pursue long-term policies without having to worry about losing power.
pursue.zh: 一个稳定的政府可以追求长期的政策，而不必担心失去权力。

pursue.en: Henslow recognized Darwin’s curiosity and encouraged him to pursue his interests and study nature.
pursue.zh: Henslow发现了Darwin的好奇心，并鼓励他追求自己的兴趣去研究自然。

pursue.en: They pursued him across the Mediterranean, determined to stamp out the threat once and for all.
pursue.zh: 他们在整个地中海对穷追不舍，决心一劳永逸地根除这个威胁。

pursue.en: Once I spotted a huge rat and pursued it down the hall until I drove it into a corner.
pursue.zh: 有一次我发现了一只巨大的老鼠，顺着过道追它，最后把它逼到了一个角落里。

pursue.en: His wife had stood by him while he pursued his political ambitions, and the pair had two daughters together.
pursue.zh: 在他追求政治抱负的过程中，妻子一直支持他，两人育有两个女儿。

publicity.en: The publicity turbocharged his book, and it became a massive bestseller.
publicity.zh: 这波宣传让他的书销量暴增，并成为了超级畅销书。

purely.en: Starmer didn’t really have anything. There’s nothing to really think about as a purely Starmer policy.
purely.zh: Starmer其实什么也没有。没有什么能让人纯粹联想到属于Starmer的政策。

purely.en: From a purely technical perspective, this is extraordinary.
purely.zh: 从纯技术的角度来看，这是非同寻常的。

purely.en: In the 19th century, particularly in Europe, and most markedly in Victorian England, dogs were increasingly kept purely for companionship.
purely.zh: 在19世纪，特别是在欧洲，以及在维多利亚时代的英国最为显著，越来越多的人养狗纯粹是为了陪伴。

purely.en: Code switching can also be purely efficient.
purely.zh: 语码转换也可以纯粹是为了效率。

purely.en: I assumed, when I first moved to Japan, that I wasn’t going to live here long term, and my focus was purely communication-based.
purely.zh: 刚搬到日本时，我以为自己不会在这里长期居住，我的重点纯粹基于交流。

puppy.en: And because tameness is a genetic trait, their puppies were even braver and even friendlier.
puppy.zh: 而且由于温顺是一种基因特征，它们的小狗也就更加勇敢、更加友好。

puppy.en: It allows them to raise their inner eyebrows to create what we call " puppy dog eyes."
puppy.zh: 这块肌肉能让它们的内眉上扬，做出我们所说的“小狗般委屈的眼神”。

purity.en: It was slightly more complicated than this, and activities were split up into seven factors: Intensity, Duration, Certainty, Proximity, Fecundity, Purity, and Extent.
purity.zh: 实际情况稍微复杂一点，活动被细分为七个因素：强度、持续时间、确定性、邻近性、多产性、纯粹性和范围。

purchase.en: And they could only purchase certain quantities of particular foods.
purchase.zh: 而且他们只能购买特定数量的特定食物。

purchase.en: And the nature of drug use and drug addiction is that it is, almost by definition, a repeat purchase.
purchase.zh: 而吸毒和毒瘾的本质在于，从定义上讲，它几乎必然是重复购买。

purchase.en: Our online activity is recorded on platforms, tracked in apps, and monitored at different points when we make purchases.
purchase.zh: 我们的在线活动被记录在平台上，在应用程序中被追踪，在我们进行购买时的不同时间点被监视。

purchase.en: Then in 1948, the Australian and New Zealand governments purchased Christmas Islands’ phosphate mines and industries from the British.
purchase.zh: 然后在 1948 年，澳大利亚和新西兰政府从英国人手中买下了圣诞岛的磷酸盐矿山和工业。

purchase.en: Some of this money ended up being used to purchase luxury properties in New York and London, paintings by Monet and Picasso, and a $250 million superyacht.
purchase.zh: 其中一部分资金最终被用来购买纽约和伦敦的豪宅、莫奈和毕加索的画作，以及一艘价值2.5亿美元的超级游艇。

purse.en: It was a long, dangerous and expensive trip, and carrying all of your gold and valuables in a purse, on your person, was a recipe for disaster.
purse.zh: 这是一段漫长、危险且昂贵的旅程，把所有的黄金和贵重物品装在钱袋里带在身上，简直是自寻死路。

punctual.en: I come from quite a punctual, schedule focused culture.
punctual.zh: 我来自一个相当守时、注重日程安排的文化背景。

punctual.en: From my perspective being punctual shows respect.
punctual.zh: 从我的角度来看，守时表示尊重。
